name: CapGate
mechanic: Rejects any swap larger than 5% of the pool's reserve of the token being spent.
plain: The maximum trade size scales with the pool: any swap whose amount is more than 5% of the pool's reserve of that same token is rejected before it runs. Because the cap is a fraction of the pool rather than a fixed token count, it behaves the same across any token decimals, so big players ('whales') must break their order into smaller pieces or take it elsewhere.
rules: A swap may move at most 5% of the pool's reserve of the token being spent.
The cap is a fraction of the pool, so it works the same regardless of token decimals.
Oversized swaps revert before they run.
